firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently won a game of Terraforming Mars takes the first player marker and starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The first generation skips the player order and research phases, so the first player simply begins the action phase.
In the action phase, play proceeds clockwise until everyone has passed.
From the second generation on, the first player marker shifts one step clockwise at the start of each generation.

uncertainty: The rulebook gives no tie-break if nobody, or more than one player, qualifies as the most recent winner.
